newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ligand started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ligand started at buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its anlayst Edward Hurwitz started coverage of Ligand Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy rating based on its development of drugs that regulate hormone-activated intra-cellular receptors (IRs) and signal transducers and activators of transcriptions (STATs).

-- In a statement, Hurwitz said the stock's near term driver will be Phase II and Phase III trial data from Targetrin and Panretin, two drugs that could enter the market in 1998 and generate sales over $500 million in 10 years.
-- Hurwitz targets the stock at $20 a share by year-end 1997. Ligand was up 3/4 at 12-1/4 by midday.
